summary.en: The question's machine form in one mono line under the words: fragments type as their words land, carry across asks, and drop off the front behind an ellipsis.
summary.zh: 问题的机器写法，词下方的一行等宽字：每个片段随它的词打出来，跨场延续，太长时从前面整段丢掉并加省略号。

fits: Any film whose words have a real machine form: CLI flags, a query, a bench command.
notFor: Decorative code, timecodes, HUD corners; parameters the product would not accept.

intent.en: Under every spoken word sits its real parameter, so the viewer believes the question is a real run.
intent.zh: 每个说出的词下面都有它真实的参数，让观众相信这个问题是真跑过的。

content.en: 1–8 code fragments (≤ 34 chars each) the product really accepts.
content.zh: 1–8 段产品真能接受的代码片段（每段 ≤ 34 个字符）。

fits.zh: 词有真实机器写法的片子：命令行参数、查询语句、跑分命令。

notFor.zh: 装饰性代码、时间码、HUD 角标；产品不接受的参数。

en: Only real parameters: no timecode, no HUD.
zh: 只放真实参数：不放时间码、不放 HUD。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
